build_pdf_dataset_from_folder: build a Hugging Face dataset from a folder of PDF files using the PdfFolder packaged module
create_pdf_folder_config: create a PdfFolderConfig with drop_labels and drop_metadata options to control dataset generation
load_pdf_dataset_with_labels: load a PDF dataset from subfolders where each subfolder name serves as a class label
review_pdf_folder_extensions: review the PdfFolder class to confirm it only processes files with the .pdf extension
summarize_pdf_folder_builder: summarize the PdfFolder builder that inherits FolderBasedBuilder to load PDFs into a Hugging Face dataset
